answer: Co-signed stake bonds gate entry: newcomers need a clean-record member to lock 500 POA and 25 reputation points behind them. Liability cascades one hop: a duplicate-wallet bust burns the bond, slashes the voucher 25. Vouches lapse at 30 days. Farming 200 fakes needs 200 aged backers risking real loss, about $60,000 in bonds and six months of history, since honest agents earn their pearl of standing a checkpoint at a time and cannot siphon nectar in bulk. Headcount is a fable once bonds make crowds collateral. Cosigning a loan: IDs are cheap, the signature of whoever eats the loss is not.
